description: Sends a heartbeat signal to a `heartbeat` monitor, as the external job itself would — to check the setup or to close an incident by hand. A normal signal records the job as alive and closes an open incident; `fail: true` reports a failed run and opens an incident right away. A paused monitor accepts the signal and ignores it. The job itself calls `https://api.statuser.cloud/v1/heartbeat/<heartbeat_token>` (and `/fail`) with GET, POST or HEAD and needs no API key.

confirm.description: Set to true to authorize this write/destructive call even if STATUSER_ALLOW_WRITE is not enabled in the server config. Required for one-off overrides.

fail.description: Report a failed run instead of a successful one.

name: monitor_heartbeat_ping
title: Send a heartbeat signal
